verdict.rationale: Ente states that its apps and server are open source, and a community member thanks the team for releasing it as open source. Changelog entries credit outside contributors by handle, which suggests public code contributions. However, nothing shows where the Auth client source lives, under what license, or that the seed-handling and crypto code has had community or independent security review. Missing for 10: an explicit Auth client repository and license, evidence of community or third-party review or audits of the seed and crypto code, and in-depth first-party docs on source availability.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed
